armor.name: Mud-Seer's Hood
armor.description: A cloth hood woven with Aetheric thread. Sharpens the wearer's intuition.

armor.name: Aetheric Helm of Command
armor.description: A Tartarian command helm of dark steel and Aetherstone. Steadies the channeller's hand.

armor.name: Reclaimer's Salvage Cap
armor.description: A scuffed leather cap with extra padding around the temples.

armor.name: Rough-Hewn Chestplate
armor.description: Hammered iron plate. Crude, heavy, effective.

armor.name: Sentinel's Chestplate
armor.description: Salvaged Sentinel plating. Remembers how to stand even when the wearer doesn't.

armor.name: Aetheric Vest
armor.description: A vest panelled with Aetherstone slabs. Hums softly when Aether is near.

armor.name: Ceremonial Robes
armor.description: Robes embroidered with old Tartarian sigils. Quickens the runecasting hand.

armor.name: Mud-Stalker Leggings
armor.description: Tight leather leggings made for moving through silt without sucking sound.

armor.name: Forgotten Leggings
armor.description: Scaled leggings recovered from a Forgotten Order cache.

armor.name: Mud-Lurker Boots
armor.description: Soft-soled boots, treated against mud and Aetheric runoff.

armor.name: Echoing Steps Boots
armor.description: Boots for silent movement in ruins. Even Aetherstone strains to hear them.

armor.name: Aether-Runner Boots
armor.description: Boots threaded with Aetheric soles. The ground feels different underfoot.
